dataset.description:
To conduct focus group interviews with local and regional media as well as
national media to identify the principles, policies and priorities of the media for
creating media content on security problems.
The research intends to collect qualitative data and conduct surveys or inhabitants
of Latgale region to identify factors that influence individuals’ perceptions of risks
in the context of media use.

dataset.title: Focus Group Discussions

dataset.description:
Media content analysis. The analysis is performed to identify topics, messages, narratives and the scope
related to security and risks. The research mainly analyses the media content included in the focus group
discussions, thereby determining how various sources cover security issues and how they can influence
audience perceptions. As a result, a data set is created to classify content analysis units – the kinds of risk
covered by the media.
